tools.name: remember
tools.description: Commit a fact to memory. The claim is admitted ONLY if the evidence you cite supports it — you are the proposer, a deterministic gate decides. Refusals are typed and explain what to fix. Evidence must be text you are quoting verbatim, not a paraphrase.

source_text.description: the full document this evidence was quoted from. Pass it and the claim binds to a verifiable BYTE RANGE in it — the receipt. Optional, but this is the point.

tools.name: add_source
tools.description: Register a source document so claims remembered against it bind to verifiable byte ranges.

origin.description: where these bytes came from (path, URL, endpoint). RECORDED BUT NOT VERIFIED.

origin_kind.description: the kind of origin. Recorded but not verified.

supplied_by.description: who handed these bytes over. Recorded but not verified.

validated_by.description: what checked these bytes before ingest, if anything. Recorded but not verified.

tools.name: review_reads
tools.description: What has been asked of this substrate and what it answered. Off unless FIREWEED_MCP_READ_AUDIT=1; query text is recorded only if FIREWEED_MCP_READ_AUDIT_TEXT=1 as well, otherwise queries appear as salted fingerprints.

limit.description: how many recent reads to show

tools.name: trace_evidence
tools.description: Audit BACKWARDS from a stored memory to the arrival of the evidence it rests on: the byte range it binds, whether those bytes still match, whether the document's arrival is in the append-only ledger, and whether the chain verifies. States plainly which fields are attested and which are caller-declared.

claim.description: any distinctive substring of the stored claim to trace

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search memory. Returns grounded claims with the byte ranges they came from. If the substrate cannot answer, it ABSTAINS and says which term it could not ground — treat that as a real answer, not an empty result.

tools.name: verify_receipts
tools.description: Re-hash every held source and re-slice every receipt. Tamper-evident: change one byte of a source and its receipts stop verifying.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Erase everything about a subject and issue a SIGNED CERTIFICATE: exact closure, a probe battery that must all abstain, and bystanders left intact. This is the artifact for a 'delete me and prove it' request.

tools.name: export_memory
tools.description: Export the whole substrate as a portable open-format blob. Readable without this server, without any model, with a stdlib-only reference reader.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Substrate size, entities, sources held, and mode.

tools.name: review_quarantine
tools.description: List claims the firewall held for review rather than storing. These were NOT written to memory; a QUARANTINE verdict means the claim could not be classified confidently, not that it was rejected.
